download.button: Download vanilla assets (about 45 MB, from Mojang's official servers)
download.note: This connects to Mojang's official servers (piston-meta.mojang.com, piston-data.mojang.com, resources.download.minecraft.net) and downloads the latest Minecraft Java Edition release client jar, plus a few dozen sound files the built-in templates commonly use (estimated under 2 MB), into this app's data folder on your computer. Only its textures and sounds are read. Later, the app fetches another sound's file from resources.download.minecraft.net only when you preview or pick that sound, or confirm fetching before an export. No personal information is sent, nothing updates automatically, and nothing is downloaded in bulk in the background.

noWebgl.title: Your graphics card or driver does not support WebGL 2
noWebgl.body: Preview and export both render with WebGL 2. Without it the app cannot draw anything, so it stops here instead of showing a blank window.

tips.driver: Update the graphics driver from your GPU vendor (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel), then restart the app.
tips.gpu: On laptops with two GPUs, try running the app on the other one (Windows Settings → System → Display → Graphics).
tips.remote: Remote desktop sessions and some virtual machines have no WebGL 2; run the app on the machine itself.
